elements.element: TrueLink must provide transition assistance upon expiration or termination of the Agreement.
elements.evidence: The added provision applies upon expiration or termination for any reason and requires TrueLink, at Client's request, to provide reasonable transition assistance.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to six months.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly provides transition assistance “for up to six (6) months.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided at TrueLink's then-current rates.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly applies “TrueLink's then-current rates.”

elements.element: TrueLink must return all Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: TrueLink must return to Client all Client Content and other Client data in its possession or control.

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned within 30 days after expiration or termination.
elements.evidence: The 30-day period runs from Client's request, not from expiration or termination. Client could request return later, so return is not required within 30 days after the agreement ends.

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: The clause requires a “commonly used, machine-readable format,” which satisfies the standard machine-readable format requirement.

elements.element: TrueLink must delete the returned Customer Data thereafter.
elements.evidence: Subsection (c) requires TrueLink thereafter to delete the returned Client Content and Client data from its systems.

elements.element: TrueLink must certify deletion to Customer thereafter.
elements.evidence: Subsection (c) requires TrueLink to certify the deletion to Client in writing.

elements.element: TrueLink must provide transition assistance upon expiration or termination of the Agreement.
elements.evidence: The added provision requires transition assistance upon expiration or termination for any reason, at Client's request.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for at least 90 days.
elements.evidence: Availability for up to six months exceeds the 90-day fallback period.

elements.element: TrueLink must export or return Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: The clause requires return of all Client Content and other Client data in TrueLink's possession or control.

elements.element: Customer Data must be exported within 30 days after expiration or termination.
elements.evidence: The clause measures the 30-day deadline from Client's request rather than from expiration or termination, so the fallback deadline is not assured.

result.reason: The redline substantially implements the preferred position, including six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, machine-readable data return, deletion, and written certification. However, its data-return deadline is triggered by Client's request rather than by expiration or termination. Consequently, data could be returned more than 30 days after the agreement ends, defeating both the preferred and fallback timing requirements. Because no complete level is reached, the redline is not minimal as defined. The added provision otherwise leaves unrelated commercial terms effective and introduces no apparent contradiction.
